title: Extend the incident review with 2015–2026 ejection and fall cases
context: RideBelt is an open, safety-critical Hee-Lee Oss project: an optional rider-worn backup restraint (low hip belt + short tethers; optional clip-on Shoulder Module or one-piece Integrated Harness) that latches into an open seat anchor standard (RAS). ALL safety content is DRAFT and not for use until a credentialed engineer signs off at the MVP gate (GOVERNANCE.md). Never remove a DRAFT banner, never give instructions for wearing or attaching anything to a ride, never copy text from paid standards (cite by number and title only), never name private individuals or incident victims, and respect the patent design-arounds in docs/research/patentability-fto.md. The review has 26 cases and was compiled by searching for ejections specifically. More recent cases (e.g., from the Woodcock monthly ride-incident recaps and national regulators) would strengthen the failure-mode tally. Depends on: ridebelt-incidents-002 (do those first or use their outputs if merged).
objective: Add 10–20 further rider ejection or fall-from-ride incidents from 2015–2026, classified with the existing failure-mode codes and RideBelt-applicability reasoning.
acceptanceCriteria: Uses the existing table columns and status labels
Classification reasoning is conservative (structural/trajectory cases = No)
Tally and 'what it means' sections updated
Every factual claim has a cited, working source link; estimates are labelled as estimates
